Use llama-bench -m FIRST_SHARD -p 256 -n 128 -d 0 -b 256 -ub 256 -t 2 --poll 0 -r 2 -fa auto -ctk f16 -ctv f16 -ngl 99 -dev OBSERVED_METAL_DEVICE -o json -v; require full offload and resolved Flash Attention, record thermals and power source. compute_receipt_contract.description: No receipt is supplied or fabricated. Parent must emit these fields only from actual successful current-boot hardware qualification for the exact ICD selected. Guard performs no GPU commands and never changes capabilities.

required_fields.icd_manifest_sha256: SHA256 of the exact selected manifest bytes
required_fields.icd_library_sha256: SHA256 of the concrete library identified by ICD.library_path
required_fields.llama_device: Exact explicit device observed under that ICD, e.g. Vulkan0
required_fields.hardware: boolean true from actual hardware identity
required_fields.compute_queue: boolean true only if an actual compute-capable queue was observed and used
required_fields.storageBuffer16BitAccess: boolean true from actual Vulkan feature query; mandatory upstream
required_fields.device_extensions: Actual extension-name list, including upstream-required VK_KHR_16bit_storage
required_fields.compute_dispatch_passed: boolean true only after real bounded shader execution completed
required_fields.compute_readback_passed: boolean true only after shader output matches the known CPU/reference result
required_fields.validation_clean: boolean true only if actual compute run had no validation diagnostics
required_fields.evidence: Nonempty array of {path,sha256}; paths relative to receipt, preserving actual compute/readback/validation logs

compute_receipt_contract.failure_policy: Missing/stale/failed proof, missing mandatory features, changed ICD/library/evidence, software renderer, unexpected device, runtime diagnostics or missing actual full layer offload block Vulkan. CPU can build and run independently. Never disable F16/cooperative kernels to conceal a feature failure; never force memory limits, fake device names, set MESA/Vulkan version overrides or global loader variables. Fix the shared Mesa/kernel contract and requalify instead.

bounds_and_interpretation: Run one command at a time. Defaults are two threads, zero threadpool polling, nice 10, pp64/tg16, batch/microbatch 64 and one measured repetition plus upstream warmup. Longer bounded comparisons may use --generation 256 --repetitions 2 and matched thread counts.

Each comparison has a 180-second deadline plus five seconds to terminate. The launcher samples battery gauge power, die temperature and fan RPM once per second and stops the child group if TCMb reaches 80°C or its reading is invalid. This is a benchmark stop condition, not a firmware thermal policy. No retries or CPU fallback for a failed Vulkan run.

Hash both official 7B shards independently; pass the first to the pinned split loader (no merge). 7B revisions, sizes and hashes are in benchmark-7b.json. The public 135M and 1.5B models remain the defaults; preserve applicable licenses and model cards when redistributing.

Compare CPU and Vulkan on the same model separately for prompt processing and generation. Keep power source, temperature, desktop load and cooling policy unchanged; allow cooldown between runs. Wall time includes loading/warmup; bench token throughput does not include tokenization/sampling.

Use --depth 512, 2048, or 4096 on both arms to time prompt append and single-stream generation with prefilled KV, not at an empty context. For native llama-bench pass the same -d value. Priming is excluded from the throughput rows but included in the deadline and wall-time/telemetry window.

Single short runs are exploratory, not statistical, sustained-thermal, accuracy or tokens-per-joule evidence. Do not claim a hardware speedup or deploy a Vulkan default until actual outputs and shared compute safety are qualified.

CPU and Vulkan are separate private builds with GGML_NATIVE disabled and a checked explicit armv8.6-a+dotprod+fp16+i8mm contract. No SVE/SME assumptions, external CPU-kernel fetches, global installs or system-library replacement.

llama-cli is gated behind LLAMA_BUILD_SERVER in this pinned release. Build llama-completion and llama-bench only with server/app/UI disabled; no ports are opened and no dictation models or user caches are read.

Compare borealis-gemv against borealis with identical weights and context depth. The only additional change is the G17S Q4_K/Q6_K selector for eligible single-column, non-integer-dot operations. Keep it isolated from installed runtimes.

The stock Vulkan source is an unmodified diagnostic control; do not use its timing as a qualified baseline when cooperative attention validation fails. Compare attention versus borealis to isolate tuning after applying the same CM1 correctness fix to both. Keep --profile runs separate from timings.
